primary_navaid_note: There is NO navaid at PGD in NASR (no NAV_BASE row named for the airport; the ILS DME is the airport's own DME source). The ILS 4 plate and the 4 and 33 RNAV plates use the LEE COUNTY VORTAC (RSW, 114.15, chan 88Y, 26.52988669 N 81.7757685 W, NASR status OPERATIONAL RESTRICTED, variation 2W epoch 1985) about 24 NM south-southwest of the airport as IAF / feeder and for the plate distances (computed from the NASR coordinates, not an FAA-published figure).
ils_note: One ILS exists: runway 4 (I-PGD 109.75, ILS/DME channel 34Y, GS 333.05, category I, NASR ILS_BASE system type LD, status OPERATIONAL IFR, remarks 'ILS CLASSIFICATION CODE IA' and 'ILS UNMON WHEN ATCT CLSD'). Runways 22, 15 and 33 have no ILS or LOC (RNAV (GPS) only); runway 9/27 has no approach. NASR lists no marker beacons.
navaid_unverified: Fix roles are human-read from the plate images; verify against the PDFs before safety-critical use.

star.restriction_notes: No crossing restriction is printed for the PGD body or the common legs; the chart prints minimum en route altitudes along the legs as '*1200' (GNSS MEA) with a maximum authorized altitude (FL180; 11000 between BAGGS and PIKKR), kept as mea_ft / noted here, not used as restrictions. The chart prints no runway for PGD: the same GUSEC leg is given to runways 4, 22, 15 and 33 (NASR STAR_APT RWY_END_ID 'ALL'); runway 9/27 is not modelled. Charted tracks are 3 degrees less than true + 6 W on every leg (chart variation about 3 W; distances agree).
star.verification: NASR 2026-10-01 STAR_RTE.csv lists exactly these transitions (CODGR, PLYER, REMIS, all ending at PIKKR) and the body PIKKR-GUSEC; printed distances agree with the great-circle distances between the NASR FIX_BASE coordinates within 1 NM and printed tracks with true + 3 W within 2 degrees (src/airport/kpgd/stars.test.ts).
star.not_transcribed: The KAPF/KMKY body (ZEILR, ISAJY); the holding patterns at OBESE, WHITL and CODGR; the FL180 / 11000 maximum altitudes as structured data.

stars_note: Two STARs list PGD as a served airport (NASR STAR_BASE SERVED_ARPT; the d-TPP metadata files them under PGD): LUBBR FOUR (RNAV; PGD body LUBBR-ROSTY, ends 'then on heading 150', radar vectors) and PIKKR SEVEN (RNAV; PGD body PIKKR-GUSEC, ends 'then on heading 118', radar vectors). Both are transcribed for the PGD bodies only. The charts give no runway for PGD, so the one leg is copied to runways 4, 22, 15 and 33 in the dataset.
sids_note: No SID and no DP: the d-TPP metadata has no DP record for PGD and NASR DP_CSV (x_DP_CSV) has no row for PGD. The simulator therefore uses its default initial altitude (DEFAULT_INITIAL_ALTITUDE_FT in src/sim/ifr.ts) for departures: there is no published initial altitude to read.

supporting_charts.alternate_minimums: PUNTA GORDA (PGD) (SE3ALT.PDF page 5): ILS or LOC Rwy 4 (notes 1, 2); RNAV (GPS) Rwys 4, 15, 22, 33 (note 3). NA when local weather not available. 1: NA when control tower closed. 2: LOC Cat D 800-2 1/4. 3: Cat D 800-2 1/4. (No standard alternate minimums line is printed: the entries use the footnotes only.)

not_included: No RNP, special-authorization or helicopter approach exists for PGD in the d-TPP metadata.

Holding patterns and fix altitudes of the plates are NOT transcribed as structured data for KPGD (data/sources/kpgd-holding-patterns.json / kpgd-fix-altitudes.json do not exist): every KPGD IAP has empty holdingPatterns and fixAltitudes.
No MVA sectors: the FAA MVA chart for the Fort Myers approach control was not downloaded, so mvaSectors is empty.
The ALTERNATE MINIMUMS page lists weather minima for dispatch only; not used.
